DriverNotes.Text: Other traffic was moving faster than the camera vehicle.
The camera vehicle was speeding up in the seconds before the collision.
No braking was seen before the impact; there was little time to react.
The camera doesn't show the inside of the cab, so phone use or other distraction can only be judged from how the vehicle moved.

Narrative: At 0:50.9 the video shows a side-impact (crossing) collision, directly ahead in the camera vehicle's lane, at the front of the camera vehicle. Involved: the camera vehicle, V1 (black car). 117 other road users were in view but not involved. Fault looks shared: the camera vehicle 50%, V1 black car 50%. Nothing in the camera vehicle's own driving stood out as a cause.
